violations.text: Bowls are being used as scoops in containers of nuts. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. New Violation. Correct By: 08/18/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the mixer have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 08/18/2026
The faucets of the hand sinks in the restrooms were observed with an active leak. New Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2024
